LOG IN OR SIGN UP

Log in to JR Space

Your lists, campaigns and settings stay tied to this browser.

No real Google, GitHub or Apple sign-in happens here — JR Space has no server. These buttons only save a name and email in this browser, on this device. Nothing is sent to Google, GitHub or Apple.

OR LOGIN WITH EMAIL

Local login — accounts are saved in this browser only; real Google/GitHub/Apple sign-in needs a server, so the buttons above only save a name and email here. Nothing is sent anywhere. Forgot your password? Use the reset link above — the new password replaces the one stored in this browser.
